articles.summary: Program advances Jackson’s growth and diversification strategy, increases access to annuities Jackson National Life Insurance Company ® (Jackson®), the main operating subsidiary of Jackson Financial Inc. i (NYSE: JXN), today announced a new annuity program – AARP® Annuity Program from Jackson, an exclusive offering created for AARP members. Through the program, AARP members will have access to a distinct set of Jackson annuities and educational resources designed to help support financial security and retirement confidence. The initial launch of the program is expected on November 16, 2026, in 10 states, with broader availability targeted during the first half of 2027. The program advances Jackson’s growth and diversification strategy and expands consumer access to annuities. “This program reflects Jackson’s continued focus on growth, diversification and meeting consumers where they are in their retirement planning process,” said Alison Reed, EVP, Head of Distribution, Jackson
articles.title: Jackson Announces New Annuity Offering for AARP Members
